# Scooter Media

> Scooter Media is an India-based creative production company founded in 2013. It produces commercials, branded films, corporate videos, digital content, photography, animation, CGI and AI films for clients in India and worldwide.

## Core services

- End-to-end film and video production
- Commercial and branded content production
- Corporate video and documentary production
- Campaign and product photography
- 2D and 3D animation, CGI and visual effects
- AI-assisted filmmaking
- Editing, colour, sound and post-production

## Locations and coverage

- Mumbai: Scooter Media LLP, WeWork, Enam Sambhav, C-20 G Block, BKC Road, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400051, India
- Dubai: Scooter Media Collective – FZCO, Building A1, Dubai Digital Park, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Vancouver, Canada
- Production coverage: across India and international markets
